## Local AI fallback

- Retry empty or thinking-only Ollama chat responses using the generate endpoint if the chat retries fail.
- Retain drawing images in generate requests and report an error if no usable response is returned.
- Update setup and troubleshooting guidance. The additional attempts can take time and may not resolve every failure.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.36...v0.1.37
